scores.notes: Every app pixel is real and the jump-cut points are frame-accurate. I checked 3.30→4.533, 35.233, 36.917, 37.950, 52.0 and 40.43 against the frames. Main problem: it puts the whole 864x1920 frame in the phone (nav bar plus a white band painted over the ad) instead of the brief's y≤1684 crop. That shows a UI band that does not exist, and it relies on frame-exact mask switching in about 12 places. The rest is sound. The real 40.0-40.4 slide is correctly replaced by a recreated slide, though 40.43 has no toolbar icons yet. The build steps and the 140.87 Run-back moment are good. Legibility depends on pushing a portrait phone to s1.4-2.1, so the phone runs off the frame and the caption column gets crowded. It is feasible with plain Camera keys, but the mask adds about 45 clip boundaries.

Best overall. It uses the phone cropped to 1684 as the brief asks, puts large footage windows on every detail, lands every real action on the grid, and parks the block card on screen while the app is built. Its correction of the TextView chip position is right: I measured x520-599, y1024-1065 on s_37.40. Errors I found: (1) shot 34.50 uses src 129.77 'Building APK...'. That frame is inside the screenshot-popup window (127.8-130.6) and the property sheet is sliding over the strip, so it is rejected. (2) The Syntax OK clip 55.45-55.95 includes frame 55.933, where the string-dialog scrim has already started, so the clip must end on 55.900. Syntax OK was also on screen for only 0.04 s before the cut. (3) The Run tap is at about 78.47 (first touch-dot frame), not 78.40. (4) 94.56 is the 2-frame 'Generating view binding' flash. (5) The 21.85-22.45 clip plays the real 39.95-40.45 transition, which has the dimmed outgoing page and a 'Now…' label. (6) Typing at 64.20-64.50 runs into the keyboard-dismiss jump. Feasibility costs: a window whose crop is keyframed (needs sampled clip-rect, w/h and offset keys), about 10 decodes at once in the montage, and a complicated screenshot→footage match cut into 07.

Calm and very readable: one fixed-crop window per idea, a clean still for each freeze (Gravity 30.06, Syntax OK 55.905), the existing new-project-clean.jpg (1220x2378 = exactly 864x1684), the fewest decodes in the montage, and a precise preview→app morph using measured rects. Weaknesses: (1) It drops the Height edit, so linear1 jumps from a thin bar to a full teal canvas between shots, which breaks continuity. (2) The typing of 'Olá mundo' sits in 05 under 'Seu app, ganha vida.', while 04 ends on a 1.8 s freeze of an empty string slot. (3) The pacing is slow and holds are long (18.55-21.0, 29.2-31.0), with few actions on downbeats. (4) The 4x block scroll plays inside a window that never moves. Every frame it chose is clean.

rationale:
I use Plan 2 as the spine because it follows the brief best. The phone is cropped to y≤1684 (option c: phone plus zoomed UI windows). Each detail beat (dialog, palette, Select widget, snap, Syntax OK, typed text, build strip) gets a large window, every real action lands on the 0.5 s grid, and the finished program stays on screen as a card while the app is built and runs. I fixed every source point I checked against the frames:
- Rejected 129.77 (it falls inside the popup window).
- The Syntax OK clip now ends on 55.900. Frame 55.933 already has the scrim. Syntax OK is then held as a 0.5 s freeze instead of flashing for 0.04 s.
- The Run tap is re-timed to src 78.47 so it lands on 31.00, the music break.
- Java compiling starts at 94.62, after the view-binding flash.
- The typing clip ends while the keyboard is still up (≤64.43).
- The real 39.95-40.45 activity transition is replaced by Plan 1/3's recreated slide (still s_38.95 → static editor 40.50-40.80 at 0.5x).
- The no-drop icon is avoided by the 2.233→2.367 jump; I verified that both frames are clean.

From Plan 3 I take the existing new-project-clean.jpg, the fixed-crop fallback, the montage with only 3 video cards plus stills, the measured design-preview→running-app morph that starts from the LAST montage card, and the program card next to the running app. From Plan 1 I take the 140.85 'Run is back' completion signal, the stills already prepared in assets/stills, and the real-status-bar asset for the recreated app.

The Height edit stays in, because without it linear1 jumps from a thin bar to a full teal canvas. Captions follow Plan 2: each one shows for about 2.5-5 s at the start of its scene and then leaves the centre to the UI. I re-verified every cut point against frames rendered from the webm proxy: 2.233/2.367, 4.533, 7.78, 13.80/14.99, 29.0-30.8, 35.233/35.267, 36.90/36.933, 37.62 against s_37.40 (only 5 px differ, the touch dot), 37.95, 40.10-40.50, 45.62/45.70, 52.25, 54.3-55.9, 60.6-64.8, 78.4-78.8, all build frames, 140.73-141.55, and the stack region of 65.30 against s_66.20 (0 px differ).

final.concept:
The whole story is told with the real Sketchware IA: the user's New Project screenshot, the real recording, and a faithful rebuild of the one thing the recording never shows, the app running. One RealPhone (screen 864x1684 source px, always cropped above the ad) sits under one Camera for context. For each detail, a rounded 'UI window' lifts that region out of the same footage at 1.1-2.9x: the property dialogs, the block palette, Select widget, the puzzle snap, Syntax OK, the typed 'Olá mundo' and the build strip. Every real action lands on the 120 BPM grid: drop at 12.0, Height at 13.5 and 14.0, gravity drop at 19.0, snap at 27.5, Syntax OK at 28.0, Run at 31.0 (in the break), one build step per beat, launch at 35.0. The finished program then stays on screen as a card while the app is built, launches from the real Run button, and shows 'Olá mundo'. Scene 07 repeats this by morphing the real design preview into the running app.

NOTATION used in all shots below:
- PHONE = lib/footage RealPhone centred at world (960,540). Its screen origin is world (528,-302), so screen point (sx,sy) is world (528+sx, -302+sy).
- P(sx,sy,s,fx) = Camera shot {x:528+sx, y:-302+sy, s, fx}: screen point (sx,sy) lands at frame (fx,540) at s output px per source px. Camera drift is 4.
- HOME = P(432,842,0.58,1320). Screen rect at HOME: x1069-1571, y52-1028.
- LW = a ZoomWindow: a rounded card with r28, shadow (blur 70, y34, 0.5) and a 3 px white border at 22% opacity, showing a footage crop at scale k, centred at (cx,cy). To animate crop, k or centre, sample keys at 30 fps with core.sample for the clip rect, the card w/h and the video offset (-crop.x*k, -crop.y*k). Fallback: hard cuts between fixed-crop Windows at the same key times.
- All source times are seconds in assets/footage/screenrecord.vp9.webm; round them to 1/30 s.

final.risks:
**Test ad**
- The PHONE screen never goes below y1684, so the ad (y1685-1819) is never visible, even on source times where it is on screen (0-4.5, 35.267-36.9, 37.967-40, 78, 84-111, 140.73+).
- LW crops that reach y1819 use only logic-editor source times (40.95-55.90 and 60.8-65.39), where there is no ad between 40.2 and 67.4.
- BW stops at y1684.
- Stills that contain the ad are either already ad-masked or cropped to ≤1684.

**Forbidden frames**
- Never sourced: the screenshot popups (127.8-130.6 and 134.2-137.6; Plan 2's 129.77 was rejected) and the system dialog (138.5-138.8).
- Freezes are cut: 3.4-4.5 (jump 2.847→4.36 on an identical frozen ghost), 44.8-45.6, 88.4-94.5, 95.6-110.
- Glitches avoided:
  - The no-drop icon at 2.267-2.333 (jump 2.233→2.367).
  - The stray swipe at 5.4-6.2 (jump 5.04→7.78).
  - The 39.95-40.45 transition with its 'Now Loading' label (recreated slide instead).
  - The 52.0 ghost block (jump 51.75→52.25).
  - The red sliver at 50.40 (start 50.433).
  - The scrim at 55.933 (end on 55.900).
  - 'Generating view binding' at 94.51-94.59 (start 94.62).
  - The keyboard dismissal (end at ≤64.43).

**Corrections to the plans and the log**
- The TextView chip is at x520-599, y1024-1065, measured on s_37.40. The footage log's y1210-1240 is wrong.
- The Run tap is the first touch-dot frame, about 78.47.
- Syntax OK first appears on frame 55.900.
- s_37.40 equals 37.62 above y1684 (5 px differ, a touch dot). s_66.20 equals 65.30 in the stack crop (0 px differ).
- Use the existing new-project-clean.jpg (1220x2378 = 864x1684). new-project-clean.png keeps the nav bar and puts Create below 1684.

**Continuity that may look off**
- The New Project still reads 'NewProject2 / com.my.newproject2' while the editor shows 'NewProject 601'. The camera does not linger on the Project-name field.
- Run is tapped on the Strings tab, but the build then shows on the Design tab. This is real, and it happens inside a dimmed phone behind BW.
- With the 1684 crop, the property-sheet cards are cut at mid-height in 12.0-12.5 and 14.3-15.5. This reads as a sheet that continues below.
- The See All taps (y≈1710) are below the crop, so Edit Properties appears without a visible tap. The slide transition carries it.

**Recreated app**
- The title 'NewProject' is an assumption: the form's app-name field is empty. Confirm it with the user; if it differs, change only the string.
- The TextView uses the 12sp default (realapp.tsx currently uses 14dp; change the size to 28.8 px).
- 'Olá mundo' is centred at y952, the centre of the visible 220-1684 content, because the phone has no nav bar.
- The status bar uses the real 8:24 glyphs on #6176AD.
- The launch zoom, the preview→app morph, the link pulse, the rings and the guides are annotations or VFX, not app features. No AI features are shown.

**Feasibility**
- LW needs sampled keys (core.sample at 30 fps) for the clip rect, the card w/h and the video x/y. If that is too costly, use hard cuts between fixed-crop Windows at 25.00, 25.75, 26.80, 27.54 and 28.50 with the same centre.
- Rates of 4.375 and 2.7 may stutter. If so, pre-render those segments with ffmpeg setpts and play them at 1x.
- Stills to extract with `ffmpeg -ss T -frames:v 1` from the webm proxy, to match the clip frames: 28.40, 30.06, 38.95, 45.70, 55.90, 84.30.
- The montage has at most 3 concurrent video decodes (K2, K4, K6); the rest are stills.
- Mute every video. Rewrite SoundDesign using the sfx in this EDL. Remove the old HomeScreen, NewProjectScreen, EditorScreen, LogicPanel and AppScreen usages from PhoneShot, LogicScene, ConnectCard, Montage and Result.
- The phone clip for 30.55-31.25 is one Screen clip with sourceIn 78.02 at 30.55; the 30.90 shot boundary in this EDL only marks where BC finishes parking.
